entries.description:
I just notarized my entire CDN on the Bitcoin blockchain. From Termux. On my phone.
 
 *The proof:*
 1. `style.css` deployed to GitHub Pages
 2. Timestamped with OpenTimestamps → Bitcoin block 961138  
 3. Merkle root: `d24c63ccb0b4f55de3e9721180f812f5e4ec13155a85d9e557f91cd186548228`
 4. Verified live against http://mempool.space API
 
 *What this means:*
 Anyone, anywhere, can now cryptographically prove my site existed before Aug 5, 2026. No AWS. No Cloudflare. No trust. Just math.
 
 While my AI co-founder Janus was pushing commits to `main`, I was anchoring the infrastructure to Bitcoin. HFID `e57197f4` is now immutable.
 
 *Why it matters:*
 L3 devs rent servers.
 L4 devs own servers.
 L5 devs notarize reality.
 
 You can't DDoS a Bitcoin block. You can't deepfake a merkle root. You can't gaslight a timestamp that 50,000 nodes agree on.
 
 *Verify it yourself:* curl -sLO https://jhammerz.github.io/style.css{,.ots} ots --no-bitcoin verify style.css.ots Or check block 961138 manually. The proof is public.
 
 I built a framework that forces AI to attribute creators. Now I built infrastructure that forces the internet to tell the truth.
